column1: # docs/player-usermessages.tsv -- every user message stock's player classes send (UserMessageBegin in
# player.cpp, hl2/hl2_player.cpp and hl2mp/hl2mp_player.cpp of the pristine upstream), and what this
# mod's managed server does about it (lane player-msgs, 2026-10-05). Each sender went dead when
# CBasePlayer left the build: a dead stock arm we bypassed, so each is ported or ruled, never deleted.
#   ported      the managed server sends it, with a fact
#   deferred    it matters, and waits on the named port that would give it something to send
#   ruled-out   it does not apply to HL2MP multiplayer, for the reason given
#   open        a ruling this lane could not make
# PlayerUserMessagesOracleTests fails when a stock send has no row here, and ServerPlayerUserMessagesTests
# when a ported row's sender does not send it.

column6: dead arm: player.cpp left the build with CBasePlayer; once per spawn, WRITE_BYTE(0), before Battery (PlayerHudMessageTests, PlayerHudMessagesOracleTests)

column2: player.cpp CBasePlayer::UpdateClientData (worldspawn gametitle; first update only, then the world's flag clears)
column6: the gametitle key is not parsed any more (world_adapter.cpp:506, docs/divergences.md), so there is nothing to send; stock multiplayer maps write "gametitle" "0" (dm_lockdown, measured by grep of the bsp); port with the key
dead arm: WRITE_SHORT(armour) when the armour differs from what the client was told; our HUD reads PlayerNetState.Armour, the message is stock's wire for any other reader

column2: player.cpp CBasePlayer::UpdateGeigerCounter (from CheckSuitUpdate; range from trigger_hurt's DMG_RADIATION RadiationThink)
column6: every 0.25 s, range/4 as a byte when it changed, 1-in-4 reset (PlayerGeigerTests); the radiation trigger tells only UTIL_FindClientInPVS's check client (PvsCheckClient over the generic Players.BoxInPvs slot, from the check client's eyes), as stock (TriggerHurtRadiationTests)

column2: player.cpp CBasePlayer::CheckTrainUpdate (TRAIN_NEW at Spawn; driving in PlayerUse/HandleFuncTrain)
column6: the spawn's TRAIN_NEW (position 0) is sent; driving a train is unreachable on this hierarchy (FuncTrackTrain.OnControls, docs/divergences.md), so no other train state arises
summed per frame, reliable, ShowOnHud bits, poison window, time-based bits kept (PlayerDamageMessageTests, PlayerDamageReportOracleTests); U3 sent it per hit, before that nothing sent it

column2: player.cpp CBasePlayer::ShowViewPortPanel (Start/StopObserverMode: specgui, specmenu, overview); also hl2mp_client.cpp FinishClientPutInServer (info: the MOTD) and CHL2MPRules::GoToIntermission (scores)
column6: the HL2MP sends that matter: the scoreboard at intermission (CHL2MPRules::GoToIntermission, IntermissionTests) and the MOTD info panel on join (FinishClientPutInServer, MotdPanelTests); the player class own observer panels (specgui, specmenu, overview) are not sent: the one-panel client UI has no screen for them (the UI lane). CLIENT HALF (lane ui, 2026-10-05): the UI answers info (type 0 text; type 1 the InfoPanel entry through VEngineClientStringTable001, motd_text for an HTML or URL motd as stock with HTML disallowed), scores and team; live step ui-motd

column2: player.cpp CBasePlayer::RumbleEffect (RUMBLE_STOP_ALL at spawn, death and observer; weapon fire via baseentity_shared.cpp FireBullets; falls via gamemovement.cpp)
column6: gamepad haptics only; its callers are the weapon fire, fall and spawn paths, none of which carries a CBasePlayer here; port with a gamepad

column2: hl2/hl2_player.cpp CHL2_Player::OnSquadMemberKilled (input from the player's AI squad)
column6: single-player: the sender is the player's NPC squad (following citizens), and HL2MP has no NPC squad members
dead arm: reliable to the taker after the item is given; nothing is sent when nothing is given (PickupUserMessageTests)
dead arm: the client's ammo index (AmmoCatalog.WireIndex, from 1 as CAmmoDef); covers ammo items and a duplicate weapon's ammo (PickupUserMessageTests)

column2: util.cpp UTIL_SayText2Filter, from client.cpp Host_Say (say, say_team)
column6: not a player class's own send, listed because the player's chat is: every hearer then the sender, reliable, HL2MP_Chat_All / _Team with name and text; say_team reaches teammates only and HL2MP without teamplay has none (HostSayTests)
